ASSIGNMENTOFRENTSANDLEASES THIS ASSIGNMENT OF RENTS AND LEASES (this “Assignment"), effective as of the _day of April, 2026, is made by 710 MADISON ESTATE (NY) INC., a Delaware corporation, having an office at 46 East 61st Street, New York, NY 10065 ("Assignor"), to and in favor of CANADA LIFE EUROPEAN REAL ESTATE LIMITED, a company incorporated in England and Wales with registration number 03846823 operating through its office at Canada Life Place, High Street, Potters Bar, Hertfordshire EN6 5BA, England ("Security Trustee"), as security trustee for the Secured Parties. The maximum amount secured hereby is Fifty Million Six Hundred Thousand and No/100 Dollars ($50,600,000.00), plus interest thereon, plus costs, charges and expenses as more fully described inExhibit“B"attached hereto. WITNESSETH: A. Pursuant to a Loan Agreement dated February 18, 2014, between, inter alios, AE Properties S. a r. 1., as borrower (the “Borrower"), Security Trustee and other Secured Parties party thereto, as amended, restated and acceded to from time to time, including, without limitation, pursuant to an Amendment and Restatement Deed dated December 5, 2019, an Amendment and Restatement Deed dated September 23,2020,an Amendment Letter dated December 10,2020, and a Development Deed, dated as of the date hereof (collectively,as the same may be amended, restated, amended and restated, acceded to or otherwise modified from time to time, the “Loan Agreement"), the lenders under the Loan Agreement made certain loans to Borrower in Sterling in the aggregate principal amount of up to the United States Dollar equivalent of f286,473,483 ($371,550,793.07) (collectively, the“Loan"). B. The Loan is secured by, amongst other things, a Debenture dated February 25, 2014,a SupplementalDebenture dated December 5, 2019 and a Supplemental Debenture dated September 23, 2020 (collectively, as the same may be amended, modified or restated from time to time, the “Debenture"), each by and between Security Trustee,for the benefit of the Secured Parties, and Borrower Obligors, other than Assignor, Chicago Estate Inc., a Delaware corporation ("Chicago"), 712 Madison Estate (NY) Inc., a Delaware corporation ("712 MAV"), New York 61st Street Estate Inc., a Delaware corporation ("61s Street Estate") and AE Property Holdings (US) Inc., a Delaware corporation ("AE US"). C.As evidenced by a Fourth Amended and Restated Guaranty Agreement, dated as of the date hereof from Assignor, Chicago, 61s Street Estate and AE US in favor of Security Trustee, for thebenefit of theSecuredParties (as the same may be amended,modified orrestatedfrom time to time, the “Guaranty"), Assignor has guaranteed the payment and performance of all obligations of the Borrower Obligors pursuant to the terms of the LoanAgreement,the Debenture and the other Finance Documents. D.
